query:
*[_type == "society" && listed != false && slug.current == $slug][0]{
    _id,
    name,
    "slug": slug.current,
    province,
    region,
    founded,
    meets,
    venue,
    memberCount,
    description,
    logo,
    website,
    markBadge,
    contactEmail,
    contactPhone,
    committee[]{ role, name },
    facebookUrl,
    instagramUrl,
    annualShow,
    foundedPlaceholder,
    memberCountPlaceholder,
    meetPlaceholder,
    venuePlaceholder
  }

result.description: The Witwatersrand Orchid Society (WOS) is one of the oldest orchid societies in South Africa. Established in 1963 under its original name, the Transvaal Orchid Society, the Society has a long-standing history of promoting an appreciation and understanding of orchids and their cultivation.
result.meets: Last Sunday of every month, 1:30 PM
result.name: Witwatersrand Orchid Society
result.venue: The Floreum, Botanical Gardens, Emmarentia, Randburg, 2195
